'''Stalgis''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], serving onboard the [[Widowmaker (frigate)|''Widowmaker'']]. He was born around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], he accompanied [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], and [[Soron Hegerty]] on a scouting trip to [[Munlali Mafir]], and later on an a research trip to [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]], the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] capital. A stormtrooper named [[Tarl (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Tarl]] served under him, and was a close friend of his. Stalgis also had several close friends who perished during the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Bastion|attack]] on [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], the Imperial capital.
